license_required.quote: Only a person certified under this article shall be authorized to use the title "certified dietitian", "certified dietician", or "certified nutritionist".

issuing_authority.quote: and who is certified as such by the department pursuant to section eight thousand four of this article.

name.quote: and who is certified as such by the department pursuant to section eight thousand four of this article.

type.quote: Admission to the practice of the professions (licensing) and regulation of such practice shall be supervised by the board of regents (section sixty-five hundred six) and administered by the education department (section sixty-five hundred seven), assisted by a state board for each profession (section sixty-five hundred eight).

age_minimum.quote: Be at least eighteen years of age.

degree_required.value: bachelor's degree in dietetics/nutrition or equivalent, or associate's degree with 10 years experience
degree_required.quote: Have received an education including a bachelor's degree, or its equivalent as determined by the department, in dietetics/nutrition or an equivalent major course of study

accrediting_body.value: accredited college or university as approved by the department
accrediting_body.quote: from an accredited college or university as approved by the department, in accordance with the commissioner's regulations

required.quote: Have completed a planned, continuous, experience component, in accordance with the commissioner's regulations, in dietetic or nutrition practice under the supervision of a certified dietitian or certified nutritionist

kind.value: supervised dietetic or nutrition practice experience
kind.quote: in dietetic or nutrition practice under the supervision of a certified dietitian or certified nutritionist or a dietitian or nutritionist who is registered by or is a member of a national dietetic association or national nutrition association

exams.name: Certification examination
exams.notes: Must test a level of knowledge and experience equivalent to that obtained by satisfying the bachelor's degree pathway requirements
exams.quote: Pass an examination satisfactory to the board and in accordance with the commissioner's regulations; provided that such examination shall test a level of knowledge and experience equivalent to that obtained by an individual satisfactorily meeting the requirements of paragraph (a) of subdivision two of this section

interval_years.quote: a fee of one hundred fifty-five dollars for each triennial registration period

renewal_fee_usd.quote: a fee of one hundred fifty-five dollars for each triennial registration period

available.quote: Indorse a license issued by a licensing board of another state or country upon the applicant fulfilling the following requirements

requirements.value: File application, meet educational requirements, have satisfactory experience, pass examination, be at least 21, be a US citizen or lawful permanent resident, be of good moral character
requirements.quote: Indorse a license issued by a licensing board of another state or country upon the applicant fulfilling the following requirements

exists.quote: A state board for dietetics and nutrition shall be appointed by the board of regents, on recommendation of the commissioner, for the purpose of assisting the board of regents and the department on matters of certification and professional conduct

national_association.value: national dietetic association / national nutrition association
national_association.quote: five members registered by a national dietetic association having registration standards acceptable to the department and five members who are members of or registered by a national nutritional association having membership and/or registration standards acceptable to the department.

scope_protection.quote: Only a person certified under this article shall be authorized to use the title "certified dietitian", "certified dietician", or "certified nutritionist".

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing the profession fraudulently, beyond its authorized scope, with gross incompetence, gross negligence, or negligence on more than one occasion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession fraudulently, beyond its authorized scope, with gross incompetence, with gross negligence on a particular occasion or negligence or incompetence on more than one occasion,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing while ability is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability, or mental disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession while the ability to practice is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability, or mental disability,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being habitually drunk or dependent on narcotics or other drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being habitually drunk or being dependent on, or a habitual user of narcotics, barbiturates, amphetamines, hallucinogens, or other drugs having similar effects,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a crime under New York, federal, or another jurisdiction's law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of committing an act constituting a crime under: (i) New York State law or, (ii) Federal law or, (iii) The law of another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been found guilty of improper professional practice by a disciplinary agency of another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been found guilty of improper professional practice or professional misconduct by a duly authorized professional disciplinary agency of another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to provide professional service to a person because of race, creed, color, or national origin
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to provide professional service to a person because of such person's race, creed, color, or national origin,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting, aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to perform activities requiring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting, aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to perform activities requiring a license,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing the profession while the license is suspended, or willfully failing to register or notify the department of changes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession while the license is suspended, or wilfully failing to register or notify the department of any change of name or mailing address,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing unprofessional conduct as defined by the board of regents or commissioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing unprofessional conduct, as defined by the board of regents in its rules or by the commissioner in regulations approved by the board of regents,

definition_quote.value: the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, food management and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain people's health
definition_quote.quote: Dietetics and nutrition are herein each defined as the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, food management and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain people's health.

value: Assessing nutrition needs and food patterns
Planning for and directing the provision of food appropriate for physical and nutrition needs
methods_authorized.quote: The primary function of a certified dietitian or certified nutritionist is the provision of nutrition care services that shall include: (a) Assessing nutrition needs and food patterns; (b) Planning for and directing the provision of food appropriate for physical and nutrition needs; and (c) Providing nutrition counseling.
